```yaml
name: Test Count Badge

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  update-test-count:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Count test functions
        run: |
          python count_tests.py
        env:
          # If the script requires any env vars, set them here
          PYTHONUNBUFFERED: 1

      - name: Update README badge
        run: |
          # Replace the placeholder [test-count-badge] with the badge image
          # If the placeholder does not exist, append the badge after existing badges
          if grep -q '\[test-count-badge\]' README.md; then
            sed -i 's|\[test-count-badge\]|![tests](https://img.shields.io/endpoint?url=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/${{ github.repository }}/main/test-stats.json)|' README.md
          else
            # Append badge after the first line of badges (assuming badges are in the first line)
            first_line=$(head -n 1 README.md)
            new_line="${first_line} ![tests](https://img.shields.io/endpoint?url=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/${{ github.repository }}/main/test-stats.json)"
            sed -i "1s|.*|${new_line}|" README.md
          fi
        shell: bash

      - name: Commit and push changes
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add test-stats.json README.md
          # Commit only if there are changes
          if ! git diff --cached --quiet; then
            git commit -m "Update test count badge"
            git push
          else
            echo "No changes to commit."
          fi
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        shell: bash
```
